prompts.title: Prototype Usability Audit
prompts.description: Evaluate a Figma prototype for usability, clarity, and task flow efficiency.
prompts.prompt: As a senior product designer, evaluate this prototype for usability and task clarity. List pros, cons, and specific recommendations for improving flow efficiency before testing.

prompts.title: Interaction Flow Evaluation
prompts.description: Analyze user interaction flow and identify unnecessary steps or friction points.
prompts.prompt: Review this user journey for interaction clarity. Identify steps that could be removed or simplified to reduce user friction and cognitive load.

prompts.title: Visual Hierarchy Feedback
prompts.description: Evaluate hierarchy and readability of components within a prototype.
prompts.prompt: Assess this screen for effective visual hierarchy. Are key elements drawing the right attention? Suggest layout or contrast improvements to improve scanability.

prompts.title: Cognitive Load Assessment
prompts.description: Detect information overload or decision fatigue in a complex flow.
prompts.prompt: Evaluate this prototype for cognitive load. Identify areas where users may experience confusion or decision fatigue, and recommend simplifications.

prompts.title: Micro-Interaction Review
prompts.description: Review animations and transitions for purpose, speed, and consistency.
prompts.prompt: Examine micro-interactions in this prototype. Are animations serving a functional purpose or creating distraction? Suggest timing or easing adjustments if needed.

prompts.title: Onboarding Clarity Check
prompts.description: Identify potential confusion points in onboarding or first-time use flows.
prompts.prompt: Analyze the onboarding flow in this prototype. Highlight moments where first-time users may get stuck and suggest improvements to copy or visual cues.

prompts.title: Feedback Clarity Review
prompts.description: Ensure feedback messages clearly communicate system responses.
prompts.prompt: Review success, error, and confirmation messages in this prototype. Are they visible, consistent, and clear? Recommend adjustments to tone or timing.

prompts.title: Error State Review
prompts.description: Analyze how error states communicate cause and recovery paths.
prompts.prompt: Inspect error states across the prototype. Do they help users understand what went wrong and how to recover? Suggest ways to clarify or simplify recovery actions.

prompts.title: Developer Readiness Audit
prompts.description: Identify missing context, unclear logic, or handoff blockers for FE devs.
prompts.prompt: As a front-end developer, review this prototype for missing details that would block implementation. Note unclear logic, states, or layout ambiguities.

prompts.title: Design Intent Summary
prompts.description: Summarize the purpose and intent of the design for developers.
prompts.prompt: Summarize this screen’s design intent including user goal, expected behaviors, and rationale. Output a concise brief for developer reference.

prompts.title: State Documentation Generator
prompts.description: Document all interaction states in a developer-friendly summary.
prompts.prompt: List hover, focus, active, and error states found in this prototype. Include transitions and timing so the developer can replicate behavior accurately.

prompts.title: Design-Dev Alignment Report
prompts.description: Generate a summary of design decisions that affect technical feasibility.
prompts.prompt: Compare this prototype to common front-end implementation patterns. Identify potential friction between design and technical feasibility.

prompts.title: Accessibility Compliance Audit
prompts.description: Run an accessibility audit on color, contrast, and keyboard focus.
prompts.prompt: Perform an accessibility audit of this frame. Check contrast, font sizes, and focus order. List any issues that violate WCAG 2.1 AA standards.

prompts.title: Keyboard Navigation Review
prompts.description: Assess logical focus order and keyboard accessibility.
prompts.prompt: Evaluate focus order and tab navigation patterns in this design. Are they intuitive and consistent? Suggest improvements for accessible navigation.

prompts.title: Touch Target Validation
prompts.description: Check minimum tappable areas for mobile and touch devices.
prompts.prompt: Review all interactive elements and verify they meet 44x44px touch target guidelines. Flag elements that may be too small for mobile use.

prompts.title: Inclusive Design Review
prompts.description: Identify assumptions that might exclude users with differing abilities.
prompts.prompt: Examine this prototype for potential accessibility barriers. Highlight where assumptions about vision, motion, or cognitive ability could limit users.

prompts.title: Usability Hypothesis Generator
prompts.description: Generate hypotheses to validate through testing based on this prototype.
prompts.prompt: Based on this prototype, propose three testable hypotheses that would validate UX assumptions. Include metrics that would indicate success or failure.

prompts.title: Variant Exploration Prompt
prompts.description: Suggest small layout or copy variations for A/B testing.
prompts.prompt: Suggest three lightweight variations of this layout or copy that could improve conversion or comprehension without a full redesign.

prompts.title: Experiment Setup Plan
prompts.description: Outline what metrics and goals to track for usability testing.
prompts.prompt: Create a plan for testing this flow. Define success criteria, task completion metrics, and key UX signals to monitor.

prompts.title: Design Token Audit
prompts.description: Identify inconsistent or duplicated design tokens in this frame.
prompts.prompt: Audit this Figma frame for color, type, and spacing token consistency. List duplicates or overrides that deviate from the main system.

prompts.title: Auto-Layout QA
prompts.description: Ensure all auto-layout components follow consistent spacing logic.
prompts.prompt: Evaluate auto-layout structures in this frame. Identify uneven paddings or constraints that could break responsiveness.

prompts.title: Naming Consistency Check
prompts.description: Ensure frame, layer, and component naming follows standards.
prompts.prompt: Check naming conventions across all layers. Highlight any inconsistencies or unclear identifiers that could slow down collaboration.
